gaps.why_now: The shared Phase 12 build gate should exercise both the survey lane and the direct probe-starter gate so stale build wiring does not leave `drivers/net/virtio_net.zig` untested on current master.
A dedicated make target keeps the survey lane runnable in the same bounded way as the earlier phase slices instead of hiding the new checkpoint behind ad hoc commands.

The Phase 10 virtio core slice already covers status sequencing, feature negotiation, queue callback bookkeeping, descriptor-shape metadata, and notification accounting, which is the minimum foundation a future virtio_net starter would build on.

The existing virtio_ring helper keeps queue-shape and notification bookkeeping in memory only, which is the closest current Zigux support surface for a future virtio_net queue plan without pretending callback suppression, DMA, or transport wiring already live there.

A dedicated survey test is still the smallest truthful way to record that `virtio_net.c` is present, Phase 10 virtio groundwork exists, the probe starter is landed, and the Phase 12 build wiring still exercises that direct gate.

The lane needs a note that spells out the real scope of `virtio_net.c` and the narrow probe-only starter so future runs do not confuse a very large production driver with a ready-to-port runtime slice.

The landed virtio_net starter stays probe-time only around negotiated feature bits, queue-pair counts, ctrl-vq presence, mergeable-buffer mode, and RSS or hash-report capability so the lane can describe `virtnet_probe()` before any NAPI, XDP, DMA, or netdev registration work.

The next honest virtio_net step after the probe snapshot is now landed as one bounded queue-recovery follow-up that freezes the probe snapshot, records queue rebuild scope, and keeps reset-required plus control-vq or RSS resume intent explicit before any live DMA, NAPI, or netdev lifecycle work.

The receive-refill follow-up is now landed as one bounded packet-path step that keeps mergeable-buffer headroom, fresh probe replay after restore, RSS-aware refill requirements, and clamp-versus-single-queue recovery intent explicit before any live DMA, NAPI, or netdev lifecycle work.

The transmit-recycle follow-up is now landed as one bounded completion-side queue-reuse step that keeps packet return ordering, control-virtqueue restore ordering, RSS-aware queue reuse, and receive-refill coordination explicit before any live DMA, NAPI, or netdev lifecycle work.

The mergeable-buffer-length follow-up is now landed as one bounded throughput-facing handoff that mirrors `get_mergeable_buf_len()` by recording whether mergeable receive buffers stay at the observed average packet size, clamp to the minimum floor, cap at page payload, or switch to page-minus-room sizing once XDP headroom reserves room for `skb_shared_info`, all before any live page-pool DMA, refill loop, or NAPI execution.

NAPI poll loops, page_pool DMA handling, XDP or XSK paths, control-virtqueue commands, RSS table programming, ethtool hooks, and net_device lifecycle coverage remain blocked until a much smaller probe snapshot exists and the roadmap-approved DMA and queueing substrate is in place.
